metadata.article_title: Guidelines for assessment of specified disabilities.

article.title: Guidelines for assessment of specified disabilities.
article.content:
56Guidelines for assessment of specified disabilities.

Section 56  ·  Chapter X  ·  page 21 of the Act
The Central Government shall notify guidelines for the purpose of assessing the extent of specified disability in a person.
